## Problem and issue

Closes #

## Outcome

Describe the observable behavior now present.

## Scope and non-goals

State what changed and what deliberately did not.

## Architecture and data flow

Describe the boundaries crossed and why.

## Safety impact

Cover target warnings, process/filesystem behavior, secrets, untrusted input, and data handling where relevant.

## Verification

List exact commands and exact results.

## Visual evidence

Attach before/after screenshots for appearance and a short recording for motion, timing, resize, or interaction changes.

## Migration and recovery

Describe compatibility and recovery where applicable.

## Owner walkthrough

Provide short deterministic steps for the owner.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR has one independently reviewable reason to exist.
- [ ] Acceptance scenarios pass.
- [ ] Focused checks and required CI pass on the latest revision.
- [ ] Product warnings remain informational and every representable action remains runnable.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and evidence contain no real targets or secrets.
- [ ] Contracts and documentation match behavior.
- [ ] Visual evidence is attached where applicable.
